items.title: Fullstack Engineer
items.description: We are looking for a highly experienced and versatile Fullstack Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role requires a strong background in agile development practices, close collaboration with team members and product owners, and the ability to design and negotiate technical solutions end-to-end across the technical domain. Familiarity with AI tools and services to augment development practices is highly desirable. The Wow Our Product Development organisation spans across 5 locations, with the most creative teams in the industry! If you are passionate about the latest technologies and can handle mission-critical responsibilities, then this is the role for you! We are operating in a very competitive market therefore we MUST use latest technologies. Our aim is to create the best performance, functionality, and user experience in the iGaming industry! You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform to support 40+ online brands! Our brands are used by hundreds of thousands of users and growing. What's in it for you? Player Account Management (PAM) Area covers everything related to the management of the player accounts, such as: Account creation, verification, updates, and closure Account authentication, controls, and security User session management Responsible Gaming A taste of what you will be doing Design, develop, and maintain scalable fullstack applications using .NET (preferably .NET 9) and Angular. Integrate and manage messaging systems such as Kafka and RabbitMQ. Deploy and manage applications using Docker and Kubernetes in AWS environments. Work with various databases including PostgreSQL, MSSQL, and Couchbase. Implement search capabilities using OpenSearch or Elasticsearch. Write and maintain frontend code using TypeScript and ensure quality with Playwright or Cypress. Collaborate closely with team members and product owners in an agile environment ensuring that the organization’s business goals are met. Utilize AI tools and services to enhance development workflows and productivity. You are good at Extensive experience with .NET technologies, preferably .NET 9. Strong proficiency in Angular and TypeScript. Hands-on experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Docker, and Kubernetes. Proficient in working with AWS cloud services. Deep understanding of relational and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, MSSQL, and Couchbase. Experience with search technologies like OpenSearch or Elasticsearch. Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks such as Playwright or Cypress. Proven experience working in agile development environments. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Extra awesome Experience designing and negotiating technical solutions across teams. Ability to design and implement end-to-end solutions across the full technology stack. Exposure to and use of AI tools and services to support software development. What we offer Much like a rollercoaster, life at Betsson Group is fast-paced, full of twists and turns, and always exciting. With more than 2,800 colleagues representing over 75 nationalities across a global network of offices - including 1,500 at our operational headquarters in Malta - every day brings new challenges and opportunities to grow. It may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you thrive on innovation, enjoy pushing boundaries and want to be part of a diverse, international team, then you’ll fit right in at Betsson. Challenge Accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: HR Business Partner, EMEA
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s People team aims to hire, engage, and retain world-class talent to safely build and deploy universally beneficial Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). The HR team, a vital subset of the People team, supports a diverse group of scientists, engineers, and business professionals, with expertise spanning employee relations, immigration, compensation and benefits, learning and development, project management, and more. About the Role We’re seeking an HR Business Partner to support our growing teams across EMEA, with a particular focus on France. This role will help build scalable, locally compliant people practices and support strong employee relations as we grow. You will partner closely with regional People leadership, Legal, Employee Relations, and other People COEs to strengthen our approach to employee relations and employee representation in France. This will include building practical governance, manager practices, and operating processes that are compliant and sustainable as we scale. Beyond France, this role will serve as a trusted HR partner to managers and teams across EMEA. You will combine strong operational execution with thoughtful business judgment to support performance, organizational health, employee relations, and disciplined people practices at scale. This role reports into the International HRBP Lead, who owns regional organizational design and workforce planning. You will operate as a key regional execution partner to them, translating strategic direction into consistent delivery, elevating manager capability, and proactively surfacing people risks and themes. If you're joining us in person, we offer relocation support and follow a hybrid schedule: three days a week in the office, with the option to work from home on Thursdays and Fridays. Our offices are designed for focus and connection, with spaces for both individual work and collaboration. Your Responsibilities - Lead employee-representative work in France: Partner with Legal, Employee Relations, People Operations, and local stakeholders to own and deliver CSE-related processes, including elections, consultations, employee communications, documentation, governance, and effective ongoing operating rhythms. - Build sustainable employee relations processes: Help establish clear processes for engaging with employee representatives, preparing for required information and consultation processes, maintaining appropriate documentation, and coordinating inputs from relevant business and People stakeholders. - Support managers operating in the French employee relations environment: Equip managers and leaders with practical guidance on working effectively within French employment and employee-representation frameworks, escalating complex matters to Legal or specialist teams as appropriate. - Drive strong day-to-day HR execution: Partner with managers across EMEA to support performance management cycles, feedback conversations, organizational changes, and employee relations matters with consistency and care. - Be the go-to partner for frontline managers: Provide practical, timely guidance on team health, coaching conversations, policy interpretation, performance management, and manager enablement. - Support and operationalize People programs: Help implement and maintain performance, engagement, retention, and employee experience initiatives, ensuring processes are clear, scalable, and well executed across different EMEA jurisdictions. - Triage and resolve employee relations issues: Identify issues early, assess risk, recommend appropriate actions, and partner with Employee Relations, Legal, and other COEs on complex or sensitive matters. - Maintain operational rigor: Track employee relations themes, maintain complete and accurate documentation, coordinate recurring processes, and ensure actions and commitments are followed through. - Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with HRBPs, Legal, Employee Relations, People Operations, Total Rewards, and other COEs to provide a consistent and high-quality employee experience across EMEA. We’re Seeking - Strong HR foundation: Approximately 8+ years of HR experience, including meaningful experience partnering directly with managers in fast-paced, high-growth, or complex international environments as a Senior HR Generalist or HR Business Partner. - French employee relations experience: Practical experience working with French employment practices and employee representative bodies. Direct experience establishing, supporting, or working closely with a CSE, works council, or comparable employee representative structure is highly valued. - Experience with employee representative processes: Familiarity with employee elections, consultation processes, employee representative communications, and the governance and documentation associated with formal employee representation. - Execution-oriented partnership: Comfortable owning detailed, time-sensitive workstreams and coordinating across multiple stakeholders while maintaining sound judgment and strong follow-through. - Strong project management: Able to take complex, multi-stage employee-representative processes and translate them into clear milestones, owners, dependencies, communications, and operating processes. - Manager coaching capability: Able to guide managers through performance conversations, organizational changes, and employee relations issues with clarity and confidence. - Operational strength: Brings structure, organization, and discipline to people processes and can build repeatable practices as the organization scales. - Good judgment under pressure: Balances empathy, employee experience, business needs, and appropriate risk management while handling sensitive matters with discretion. - High integrity: Trusted, fair, principled, and comfortable operating in an environment where confidentiality and sound judgment are essential. - Language capability: Professional fluency in French and English is strongly preferred given the role’s responsibility for supporting employee relations and representative processes in France. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. Reporting to the Head of Content Delivery, you will be working with our content tools to ensure all content is prepared, updated, and verified prior to the launch of projects or new product features. items.title: Tech Recruiter
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Kraken is looking for experienced recruiters across a multitude of geographies, to support Tech hiring across our global business. We value speed, accuracy and a high bar and in turn you would join a team of high performing best in class individuals. You will partner with senior stakeholders and hiring managers to craft and execute strategic hiring plans that crush timelines and attract mission-aligned top players, in a ruthless competitive market. You’ll operate in a fully remote, high agency, async-native culture where speed, precision and focus aren’t optional, - they are the baseline. This is an opportunity to partner with the brightest minds in the Crypto industry, hand in hand helping shape one of the most innovative businesses in the world. THE OPPORTUNITY - Partner with Hiring Managers and teams to design and execute effective hiring strategies, supporting their decision making with sound data and market insights - Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies against prioritized requisitions with an eye on market intelligence and industry developments - Act as a force of change - navigate complex environments, force uncomfortable conversations, act relentlessly in the interest of Kraken - Own the end-to-end recruitment process, operating as a problem solver and force multiplier by removing blockers and delivering high-value hires. When a search stalls, the market is rarely the reason. You'll have the room to find what actually is and rebuild the plan without waiting for permission - Work with AI as the default - you'll have the tools, and the room to figure out what actually makes the work faster and better - Champion the Kraken culture, ensuring candidates are aligned to our mission and values - Contribute to cross-functional projects that elevate our global recruiting infrastructure and help define what “great” looks like at Kraken WHAT YOU BRING - Recruitment experience from a reputable, fast-growing, high bar technology/product business against ruthless competition. Bonus points if you’ve hacked it in crypto, fintech or any product-driven org - You think from first principles, not from the playbook. Hiring managers hand you symptoms - the diagnosis is your job. - You use AI fluently in your day to day - sourcing, screening, market mapping, reporting - and can point to where it's changed your output - High motor - you bring relentless energy and consistent effort to everything you do. You don’t coast, you’re always in motion and making things happen. - Scrappyness - you do not see problems but opportunities - Strong product sense - Sound appreciation for the fundamentals of talent acquisition, but creative and inquisitive when considering modern tactics - High agency, strong bias for action, and the confidence to push boundaries, influence stakeholders, and close exceptional talent without compromise. - Comfort in the chaos, thriving in ambiguity, owning your outcomes, and moving with urgency in a fully async, remote-native setting - Interest for financial technologies and cryptocurrency Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.title: Product Operations Manager (DesignOps)
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Product Operations Manager (Design), you will sit within Mistral's Product Operations function, with a focus on streamlining the operations of the design team. You will own how the Design team operates as a system — its cadences, its rituals, its coordination, and the connective tissue that lets designers focus on design. This role exists because a design org at our scale needs someone whose full-time job is the operating system itself: defining it, holding it, and continuously tuning it so the team runs with a heartbeat rather than on ad-hoc heroics. You will own the team's weekly and quarterly cadences — from leadership syncs to planning, retros, and share-outs — and establish how we track work, surface it outward, and make decisions. You'll design the forums where decisions get made and recorded, keep the rituals that create alignment, and aggressively cut the ones that are just overhead. Equally, you are the bridge across the org. You will coordinate the interlocks between Brand and Marketing for upcoming launches, and between Product and Product Design for the build pipeline — so interdependencies are understood and planned for, not discovered at the last minute. You will partner closely with marketing, PMs, engineering, GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping before it ships. This is a team-of-one role with a founding design-ops mentality. You will build the discipline from scratch, automate repetitive coordination with AI where it helps, and coordinate people where it matters. You report to the Head of Product Operations, working day-to-day with the Head of Design and the design team. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Define the operating system of the design team — the cadences, forums, rituals, and source-of-truth that keep the team aligned and moving forward. - Own the weekly and quarterly cadences, from leadership syncs and critiques to planning, retros, and headcount-cycle inputs. - Coordinate the Brand × Marketing and Product × Product Design interlocks so design work is surfaced with enough lead time and dependencies are planned, not discovered late. - Establish how the team tracks and shares out work — a single source of truth for status, and the forums where design is made legible to the rest of the org. - Design and hold decision-making forums so decisions get made, recorded, and not relitigated. - Separate ritual from overhead — keep the cadences that create alignment and cut the ones that are just tax. - Automate repetitive coordination, reporting, and tracking with AI so the team spends time on design, not admin. - Bring the wider Product Operations toolkit to the design team — data and analytics for transparent reporting, structured feedback loops and early-access programmes, and launch coordination that aligns design work with product release cycles and go-to-market timing. - Partner with marketing, PMs, engineering and GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. items.title: Lead Salesforce Developer, GTM Systems
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Lead Salesforce Developer – Revenue Systems to provide hands-on technical leadership for our Salesforce platform and revenue systems. You will own the technical design, development, integration, scalability, security, and reliability of Salesforce solutions supporting Sales, Revenue Operations, Partnerships, Finance, and other critical business processes. This is a hands-on engineering leadership role where you will continue to design and build solutions while also establishing engineering standards, leading technical decisions, reviewing code, mentoring developers, and improving the overall Salesforce development practice. You will: Own the technical architecture and delivery of Salesforce solutions across lead, account, contact, opportunity, partner, and revenue workflows. Design scalable Salesforce solutions spanning data models, automation, custom development, integrations, security, and reporting. Develop and maintain custom Salesforce functionality using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, SOQL, SOSL, and Salesforce APIs. Evaluate business requirements and determine the appropriate configuration versus custom-development approach. Build reusable, scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce components and frameworks. Design, develop, and support integrations between Salesforce and third-party applications using REST, SOAP, middleware, platform APIs, and event-driven integration patterns. Establish reliable data synchronization patterns covering field mapping, integration keys, duplicate prevention, idempotency, error handling, retries, monitoring, and alerting. Troubleshoot complex integration failures, data synchronization issues, API-related problems, and platform defects. Lead technical discovery, solution design, estimation, implementation planning, and delivery for Salesforce initiatives. Conduct architecture reviews, technical design reviews, and code reviews. Define and enforce Salesforce engineering standards and best practices across coding, testing, security, documentation, version control, and release management. Mentor Salesforce developers and administrators and provide technical guidance on complex technical problems. Define and maintain Salesforce environment and sandbox strategies and support CI/CD and automated deployment practices. Lead Salesforce deployment planning, validation, rollback planning, and production readiness reviews. Establish appropriate unit, integration, regression, and deployment validation testing practices. Investigate complex Salesforce defects, integration failures, data issues, performance problems, and security concerns. Lead root-cause analysis for production incidents and implement durable solutions to recurring issues. Develop and maintain operational runbooks, troubleshooting documentation, and technical documentation. Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Marketing, Partnerships, IT, Security, and other business teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Provide technical input into roadmap planning, prioritization, vendor evaluations, and platform governance. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve user experience, increase automation, and maximize the value of Salesforce. Contribute to the long-term architecture and technical strategy of Glean's revenue systems ecosystem. About you: 7–10+ years of Salesforce development experience, including significant experience with enterprise Salesforce implementations. Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, SOQL, SOSL, and Salesforce APIs. Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, including data modeling, object relationships, security and sharing, profiles, permission sets, access controls, automation, governor limits, performance optimization, and deployment architecture. Proven experience designing and troubleshooting REST and SOAP integrations. Experience working with middleware or integration platforms and enterprise application integrations. Strong understanding of integration patterns, error handling, retries, monitoring, observability, and data synchronization. Experience with Git and structured CI/CD or Salesforce release-management practices. Experience writing and maintaining automated tests and deployment validation processes. Experience leading technical design, architecture reviews, code reviews, and engineering standards. Strong production support, debugging, incident management, and root-cause analysis experience. Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and influence technical decisions. Strong stakeholder-management and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bengaluru office) AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants: Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement , and I agree to the terms.

items.title: [London] Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Partners Solutions Architect on Anthropic's Applied AI team, you'll be a pre-sales architect focused on building technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs) and cloud partners (AWS and GCP). You'll strengthen these relationships to accelerate indirect revenue, enable partners' AI practices, and execute our long-term go-to-market strategy. Responsibilities Strategic technical partnership: Act as a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team. Bring technical expertise to help us understand the partner landscape, drive key strategic programs, and find ways to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. You'll also serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues. Joint solution development: Work with partners to identify high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions, and codify reference architectures and best practices that speed time to deployment. Customer deal support: Step in to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance. Partner ecosystem and events: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, AWS summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities. Product feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns. Deliver it to the relevant Anthropic teams to inform the product roadmap and partner strategy. You may be a good fit if you have 5+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles, such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager A track record of partnering successfully with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery Exceptional ability to build relationships and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including C-suite executives and engineering and IT teams Strong presentation and technical communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools, or a background in machine learning or data science Enthusiasm for cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed A passion for using technology in ways that are safe and beneficial, and that advance the goal of safe AI systems The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £150,000 — £190,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Robinhood Crypto Product Compliance team supports Product teams in developing and launching crypto products and services in alignment with regulatory requirements. The team serves as the primary compliance partner for product initiatives, providing guidance on product design, customer communications, and operational processes related to crypto offerings. Team members work closely with Product, Legal, Risk, Marketing, and Operations teams to support compliant product launches and ongoing enhancements. This team plays a key role in helping Robinhood deliver crypto experiences that meet customer needs while maintaining strong regulatory standards! As Crypto Product Compliance Lead , you will support the development and enhancement of Robinhood’s crypto products and services. You will lead initiatives responsible for reviewing product designs, customer communications, and operational processes to support compliance with applicable regulations and firm policies. The role includes advising teams throughout the product lifecycle, from ideation through launch and post-launch enhancements. You will also work closely with Product, Legal, Risk, and Operations partners to support regulatory reviews, examinations, and business initiatives related to crypto products. This role is based in our New York, NY and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Partner with Product teams and other business partners, including Legal, Risk, and Operations, during the design, testing, launch, and enhancement of crypto products and services. Advise on regulatory requirements and operational processes related to crypto products, including consumer protection, AML, sanctions, and financial crimes compliance considerations. Develop appropriate compliance framework for new products. Review product features, customer communications, and marketing materials to support compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and firm policies. Provide timely guidance to business partners on compliance questions, regulatory developments, and product-related issues. Support regulatory examinations, inquiries, filings, and internal compliance reviews, including developing and executing compliance testing and monitoring, related to Robinhood Crypto products. What you bring Passion for Robinhood’s mission to democratize finance for all and interest in crypto products and financial technology. 7+ years of experience in financial services, including experience supporting crypto products within compliance, risk, legal, audit, or operations functions. Experience with brokerage products. Awareness of anti-money laundering, sanctions, and financial crimes compliance requirements related to crypto products. Experience advising on consumer protection requirements. Experience advising on DeFi projects. Strong understanding of MiFID requirements is required. Ability to manage projects and coordinate work across technical and non-technical teams in a regulated environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting compliance guidance to business partners and leadership teams. Familiarity with global crypto regulatory frameworks, including MiCA, is a plus. Familiarity with traditional brokerage is a plus. Insatiable curiosity. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $141,000 — $165,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $124,000 — $145,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $110,000 — $129,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.description: In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. We've scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action. The Multimodal team builds the experiences and infrastructure that move AI interaction beyond touch and text: realtime voice, vision, and the platform systems behind them. We own the full path from a user speaking into a device to an answer coming back: the realtime session infrastructure that connects clients to frontier audio models, the backend orchestration that routes, records, and supervises live sessions, and the SDK that powers voice and multimodal experiences across Perplexity's apps. You'll hire and develop engineers, set technical direction, and drive new products at the intersection of voice, vision, and agents. We work primarily in Rust and Python. - Genuine interest and adoption of AI products and willingness to learn quickly. items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood's Brokerage TPM team drives the execution of the most complex, high-stakes engineering programs in the company. We operate at the intersection of product, engineering, design, and operations — providing the structure, clarity, and momentum that large cross-functional programs need to move fast and ship with confidence. As a Staff Technical Program Manager , you will own end-to-end execution for one of the highest-profile programs in Robinhood Brokerage right now — a large-scale, cross-functional initiative with real-world impact on how millions of Americans experience financial products. You'll be the connective tissue across engineering teams, product, design, and CX, driving delivery with a high degree of autonomy. You'll also partner closely with the program's operations principal — crafting the narratives and communications that keep internal and external stakeholders aligned. This isn't a role for someone who needs constant direction. This is a role for someone who sees a complex program and knows exactly how to move it forward! This role is based in our New York City or Menlo Park office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Own end-to-end engineering execution for a high-profile, cross-functional Brokerage program — driving delivery across multiple engineering teams with minimal oversight Serve as the primary coordination layer across product, design, CX, and engineering — filling execution gaps, resolving blockers, and keeping the program moving with clarity and speed Partner with the program's operations principal to craft concise, polished narratives and stakeholder communications used across internal and external audiences Identify risks and dependencies early, create structure where it's missing, and hold teams accountable to timelines without slowing them down Provide engineering teams with the context, clarity, and decision support they need to execute confidently and efficiently Build and maintain a clear view of program health — surfacing the right information to the right stakeholders at the right time What you bring 7+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager, with a track record of independently owning and delivering large-scale, cross-functional engineering programs Strong technical depth — you understand system design, are comfortable with AWS and core infrastructure concepts, and can hold your own in engineering conversations without needing to write code Exceptional written communication skills — you write clean, concise narratives and can translate complex technical work into clear stakeholder updates High agency — you're a self-directed operator who takes a program and runs with it; you don't wait to be managed Exceptional organizational skills — you thrive in ambiguity, create structure intuitively, and give complex multi-team programs the clarity they need to move This position requires U.S. citizenship or U.S. permanent resident (green card) status What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Position Restriction: This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . Team/ Role Paragraph: FinHub owns how money moves at Coinbase. Every dollar and token that enters, leaves, or moves within the company runs through this platform - fiat across ACH, wires, cards, RTP, and SEPA, crypto across dozens of blockchain networks, and internal movement across ledgers, legal entities, and customer accounts. As a Group Product Manager on the FinHub team within Platform , you'll own the systems that ensure every fund flow reaches a correct terminal state - the controls that stop unsafe movement, the detection that catches what slips through, and the remediation that recovers it. You'll set the reliability standard for money movement at Coinbase and lead through influence to hold the company to it. What you’ll do: Own the multi-year vision and strategy for money movement reliability and controls across fiat and crypto, defining per-rail service levels and resolution targets for every fund flow. Build the controls infrastructure governing money movement - determining which risk, compliance, and financial controls apply to each flow, verifying they ran, and confirming they passed before funds move. Drive real-time detection and end-to-end tracing across payment rails, blockchain networks, controls, and the ledger to identify and resolve failures fast. Scale correctness through AI agents that propose controls from product specs, triage alerts before an engineer opens them, and remediate within governed limits. Partner with Compliance, Risk, Finance, and every product group that moves money to establish control ownership and hold teams accountable for their fund flows. Required Skills and Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with deep expertise in money movement, payments infrastructure, ledgering, or financial platforms at scale. Track record owning strategy for large-scale money movement or financial systems - payment processing, transfers, ledgers, reconciliation, or the reliability layers around them. Deep technical fluency in distributed systems, event streaming, idempotency, double-entry ledgering, reconciliation, and the design of preventive and detective controls. Demonstrated ability to set standards that other teams must meet and make them stick across organizational boundaries in a highly regulated environment. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: Commercial Counsel, Hardware
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Hardware is becoming critical to how AI gets built, and the legal questions are as new as the technology. We're hiring a Commercial Counsel, Hardware to help Anthropic's product teams move fast, build safely, and get the legal calls right. In this role, you'll negotiate a high volume of fast-moving deals for hardware, components, software, and emerging technology procurement needs. This role will also lead multifaceted technology, data, and partnership deals, many of them the first of their kind at Anthropic. You'll be the legal and risk partner that technical and business leaders turn to when they need a fast, practical read on a deal or purchase. You'll clear low risk transactions quickly, spot the ones that deserve a closer look, and build scalable solutions as new complexities come up, all while working alongside Procurement and Finance and Legal colleagues in areas like privacy, IP, and trade. Along the way, you'll also support partnerships with major tech companies, universities, and media organizations, which gives you a view across much of the business. Key responsibilities Negotiate and close a high volume of agreements for hardware and components, including review of embedded firmware and companion software licenses Structure and negotiate complex technology, data, and partnership agreements Track legal and regulatory changes that affect hardware products and components, such as product safety rules and restrictions on foreign-made components, and explain what they mean for our plans Identify trade, export control, sanctions, and supply chain concerns in cross-border sourcing, and work with our national security and compliance teams to resolve them Build and maintain self-serve guidance, templates, and AI-assisted review tools so routine purchases don't wait on Legal Manage outside counsel for specialist questions and overflow volume Cover other technology or hardware transactions on the Legal team as needed Minimum qualifications JD and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar (California preferred) Hands-on experience buying hardware and firmware, components, and software in high volume, fast-paced environments Deep experience leading complex deals, such as technology or data licensing, joint development, or supply partnerships Working knowledge of international supply chains and how sourcing choices (and their associated risks) show up in contracts (lead times, single-source risk, warranties, country of origin, higher risk jurisdictions) Working knowledge of trade and regulatory compliance for hardware, including export controls, sanctions, tariffs and customs Clear, plain communication with scientists, engineers, and operators, so legal risk turns into a decision they can act on A low-ego, "doer" attitude and real interest in taking on work outside your core practice area Intense curiosity about AI and emerging hardware, and a commitment to responsible AI development Preferred qualifications At least 8 years of legal experience in hardware or a closely related technical space, with the judgment to run risk assessments and deals on your own from day one In-house time at a hardware-intensive technology company (such as electronics, industrial automation, or complex devices) while it was scaling quickly Experience supporting product or engineering teams as a dedicated counsel Experience with facilities or on-site vendor services, including the insurance and safety questions An engineering, product, or other technical background Experience using AI tools to speed up your own legal work Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco office at least 3 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. items.description: WIRELESS REGULATORY ENGINEER – SAR ABOUT THE TEAM The Consumer Devices team at OpenAI builds products that bring advanced AI capabilities into thoughtfully designed consumer experiences. We work across hardware, software, design, and research to develop reliable products from early exploration through production. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Wireless Regulatory Engineer to support RF exposure compliance for consumer hardware. You’ll work closely with RF, antenna, hardware, software, and regulatory teams throughout the product development lifecycle, helping ensure products meet applicable requirements while maintaining a high bar for performance and user experience. This role is based in Mountain View, CA. We use a hybrid work model of four days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Develop and execute RF exposure test and validation strategies for consumer wireless products. - Partner with engineering teams to evaluate product designs and identify potential compliance risks throughout development. - Perform and analyze RF exposure measurements and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional teams. - Support product development from early prototypes through validation, certification, and production. - Coordinate testing with external laboratories and review results and supporting documentation. - Translate applicable regulatory requirements into practical engineering guidance. - Partner with RF and antenna teams to balance regulatory requirements with product performance. - Develop tools and workflows that improve testing efficiency, consistency, and data analysis. - Investigate issues, identify root causes, and work with engineering teams to develop effective solutions. - Support global regulatory certification activities for wireless consumer products. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have a Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, RF Engineering, or a related technical field. - Bring deep experience with SAR, RF exposure, or wireless regulatory testing. - Have a strong understanding of RF fundamentals, measurement techniques, and wireless systems. - Have experience translating regulatory requirements into engineering and product decisions. - Are comfortable performing hands-on testing, analyzing complex measurement data, and troubleshooting hardware systems. - Have experience working with external test laboratories and supporting product certification. - Collaborate effectively across RF, antenna, hardware, software, manufacturing, and operations teams. - Are comfortable working in fast-moving, ambiguous product development environments. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS - Experience in SAR, RF exposure, wireless regulatory engineering, or a closely related field. - Experience supporting consumer hardware from prototype through mass production. - Experience with wireless products incorporating multiple radios and connectivity technologies. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience developing test automation or data-analysis tools. - Experience supporting regulatory approvals across multiple global markets. - Experience working on products that integrate hardware, firmware, and software. items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. Our engineers work on a range of systems across the stack, including query understanding, document understanding, domain-adapted language models, natural language question-answering, evaluation, and experimentation. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Customer Care, Government Products team supports industry-changing products in collaboration with the U.S. Government, expanding financial access for millions of Americans. This role leads end-to-end Customer Care workstream management for Trump Accounts, developed and managed on behalf of the U.S. Department of the Treasury in partnership with BNY. The Program Manager is the single point of accountability for keeping the program's contact center obligations — to BNY, the U.S. Treasury, and Robinhood's own Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance, Security, and Engineering teams — running on schedule and in good standing. This role is based in our Denver, CO, Westlake, TX, or Chicago, IL office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Lead end-to-end Contact Center program management for complex, cross-functional initiatives — scope, milestones, success metrics, governance structures from kickoff through the program lifetime Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Risk to ensure CX initiatives meet regulatory requirements (FINRA, SEC, state securities regulations) Run governance cadences — steering committees, status reporting, executive updates Own risk identification and mitigation, maintaining RAID logs and escalating regulatory/operational/tech risks Manage external vendor and financial-services partner relationships — contract deliverables, SLAs, escalation paths Own change management for production changes — testing, sign-off, rollback plans Support audits, regulatory exams, and inquiries — documentation, stakeholder responses, evidence gathering Build and maintain KPI/metrics reporting for program health, adoption, business outcomes Serve as BNY Contact Center Engagement Owner during Trump Account incidents — single point of contact for RH's CX team, alongside the incident ATC Lead incident management and business continuity for production issues affecting customer-facing brokerage systems Manage the program's U.S. Treasury waiver and compliance commitments — deadline tracking, renewal reporting What you bring Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with external financial-services partners, vendors, or regulators Familiarity with financial agency relationships, trustee/custodial structures, or public-sector fintech — or comparable experience in a heavily contracted, multi-party environment Incident management and crisis communication experience — formal severity/on-call processes, cross-company coordination Comfort in ambiguity — building governance/SOPs for a first-of-its-kind program vs. an established playbook Excellent written/verbal communication, executive-level reporting for internal and external audiences Compliance-adjacent experience — regulated-data handling, contractual waiver management, third-party vendor governance Cross-functional leadership across Legal, Compliance, Security, Engineering, CX, and BPO oversight Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience; PMP or similar a plus This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents due to legal requirements. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. The OpenAI Life Sciences team works at the intersection of advancing frontier life sciences model capabilities and building products to help scientists accelerate their research and leverage the full potential of AI for scientific work. Rosalind Workbench brings together the scientific tools, data sources, interactive biology file viewers and core life sciences workflows into a central environment to help scientists investigate questions, design experiments, analyze results, and advance discovery. Rosalind Workbench can be used with any OpenAI models including GPT-Rosalind, our dedicated life sciences model, which combines frontier reasoning with specialized tool orchestration across medicinal chemistry, genomics, wet-lab assistance, and other scientific applications. Our long term vision is for teams of agents to work together across these domains, giving researchers access to broader expertise and the ability to pursue more ambitious scientific questions. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team building Rosalind Workbench and its supporting infrastructure. You’ll hire and develop engineers, set technical direction, and turn an ambitious product roadmap into focused, reliable releases. This is a hands-on leadership role. You should be comfortable reviewing architecture and code, investigating difficult failures, and helping engineers make consequential technical decisions. You’ll work closely with product, design, research, Codex engineering, and customer-facing teams to bring new scientific capabilities into everyday use. Hire strong engineers, coach technical leaders, provide clear feedback, and establish ownership and accountability across product and infrastructure work. - Drive technical planning and delivery. Translate scientific and customer needs into scoped milestones. Guide development across scientific interfaces, agent and tool orchestration, local and remote compute, durable execution, and persistent project state. Build shared components that support new scientific workflows. - Make scientific work inspectable and reproducible. Preserve the inputs, versions, results, and decisions behind an analysis. Ensure scientists can move between conversations, viewers, and follow-up investigations without losing context or control. - Own engineering quality in production. Establish testing, release practices, observability, and an effective on-call process. Improve workflow reliability, latency, and cost, and lead resolution of problems that prevent scientists from completing their work. - Coordinate across teams and partners. Align with Codex on shared platform capabilities and with customer-facing engineers on deployment needs. Lead technical decisions about building or integrating scientific tools, specialist models, data sources, and experimental service providers. - Turn customer learning into reusable improvements. Work directly with scientists and design partners to understand their workflows. Address enterprise requirements such as private compute, credentials, networking, permissions, and data handling, with clear ownership for common product improvements and customer-specific integrations. - Connect product engineering with research. Help turn capabilities proven in internal research into supported product features. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. About the Role The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support. We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution. Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day-to-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements. This Toronto-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in-office arrangement.
